description: List the social channels this workspace can publish posts to — Telegram channel, Instagram, Facebook page, LinkedIn, Threads, Viber channel — with, per channel, whether it is ready, where it posts (destination), its public address (profile: profileUrl, publicFeedUrl — a public Telegram channel reads without signing in at t.me/s/<name>, older posts via ?before=<post id> — and readableBy: anyone, login_required or not_public), its text limit (maxTextLength) and, when not ready, the setup step the person must do in Obriym. Open the profile with your own browsing to read every post the channel already has, including ones written outside Obriym. Also returns now (the current time on the workspace's clock) and the workspace time zone — build schedule_content_post times from them — the image rules, and publishingEnabled: whether the workspace owner allows AI clients to publish or schedule. Read-only. Call it before create_content_post and only target ready channels.
name: list_content_channels
title: List social channels
